req.title: Create new post
req.statement: The system shall insert a new post attributed to the logged-in user when POST /create receives a title and body, then redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'Create new post' functionality by covering positive, negative, and boundary cases. This ensures that the system behaves correctly under normal, erroneous, and edge conditions, thereby increasing confidence in the system's robustness and correctness.

tests.name: test_create_new_post_positive
actions: POST /create with valid title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as Rahul
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Create a new post
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'New Post', 'body': 'This is a new post.'})

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_create_new_post_negative
expected: Error message 'Title is required.' is flashed
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as Rahul
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Attempt to create a new post with an empty title
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': '', 'body': 'This is a new post.'})

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data

tests.name: test_create_new_post_boundary
actions: POST /create with max-length title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as Rahul
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Create a new post with max-length title and body
max_title = 'X' * 120
max_body = 'X' * 1000
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': max_title, 'body': max_body})

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
